title: Oven Roasted Ethiopian Lamb Tibs
description: A pungent and crumbly solo dinner dish featuring lamb, served in a stone bowl, with ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients and cold water, in the traditional Ethiopian tibs form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven safe stone bowl over medium high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the bowl and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cold water to the bowl and bring to a boil.
Cover the bowl with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb in the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
